description: Create an account for a person's email and a Manage key for this agent; the person claims the account from the claim link. 5 per IP and 300 in all a day. Creates an account for the person's email, with a seven-day Solo trial and a Manage key for this agent, and emails them a claim link. The trial is once per person: a mailbox that had one (plus tags and Gmail dots count as the same mailbox), or a second sign-up from one network within 30 days, gets the account on Free with no trial, and the response says so in fix. 409 email_taken when the address already has an account: its owner makes a key under Account → API keys instead. Limited to 5 sign-ups per IP and 300 in all a day (429 rate_limited).

agentName.description: The agent or product making the account, such as Claude Code. Names the key and is mentioned in the claim email.

email.description: The person's address. The account is theirs; the claim email goes there.

useCase.description: What the person wants a dashboard for, in a sentence.
